name: Riverlane
description: Riverlane is a Cambridge-based quantum computing company focused on quantum error correction (QEC) technology. The company develops hardware-agnostic QEC decoders, including its Local Clustering Decoder, that enable quantum computers to perform reliable computations at scale. Riverlane has raised over $125 million in total funding, including Europe's first Series C round in quantum computing.

products.name: Local Clustering Decoder
products.description: Hardware-agnostic quantum error correction decoder enabling reliable computation at scale across different qubit platforms

news.title: Riverlane raises $75 million to meet surging global demand for quantum error correction technology
news.excerpt: Riverlane announced that it has raised $75 million in Series C funding to deliver its groundbreaking quantum error correction (QEC) roadmap, led by Planet First Partners.

news.title: Riverlane publishes QEC Technology Roadmap that can accelerate quantum computing's path to utility scale by 3–5 years
news.excerpt: Riverlane published a QEC Technology Roadmap outlining key science and engineering milestones to scale quantum computers from experimental machines to systems capable of solving commercially valuable problems.

news.title: Riverlane publishes QEC roadmap targeting utility-scale quantum by early 2030s
news.excerpt: Roadmap details engineering milestones from MegaQuOp before the end of the decade to TeraQuOp systems in the early 2030s.

news.title: Riverlane and Unitary Foundation launch Deltakit Community Fund for open-source quantum error correction
news.excerpt: Riverlane and Unitary Foundation launched a rolling quarterly grant program offering awards of $2,000–$4,000 for external contributors building production-grade features for Deltakit, Riverlane's open-source QEC toolkit. The initiative leverages Unitary Foundation's microgrant framework, with the first cohort review beginning the week of August 17, 2026.
